steps.title: Bem-vindo: Listening - Volume 12
steps.text: In this A2-level lesson, we'll explore essential vocabulary and phrases about "Listening". Get ready to level up your real-world communication skills!

words.example: I listen to a podcast during my commute.
Sorry, could you slow down a little?

steps.text: It means: "To start a conversation in order to relieve tension.". Say the example sentence out loud:
